full_prompt_en: A square photograph shows a black-and-white linocut print lying diagonally on a brown wooden tabletop. The white paper border is clearly visible along the left and lower edges, and the top of the sheet points toward the upper right. Inside the print, several horses run from the left toward the right across a dark textured foreground. Their bodies are simplified into strong black and pale silhouettes, with legs extended and tails swept backward. A broad curving white path enters from the lower center, bends around the herd, and continues up through layered hills. The foreground on both sides of the path is filled with tightly repeated carved strokes and small plant-like marks. Mid-distance slopes are darker and broken by sweeping pale bands; at the horizon, low hills lie beneath a broad nearly white sky. Tiny bird silhouettes scatter across the upper sky, becoming more widely spaced near the top. Every tonal area is made from the contrast between unprinted paper and black ink, with some gray effects produced by dense small hatching rather than smooth shading. The photographed view is slightly oblique from above, so the printed rectangle narrows in perspective and the tabletop appears at the corners. Soft ambient light illuminates the paper evenly, while the deepest inked passages remain nearly black and the white carved lines seem bright. The rough cut edges around animal forms and the repeated gouge marks give the scene movement and a distinctly hand-carved surface. The overall composition balances a lively dark herd and textured ground with the graceful pale path and expansive quiet sky.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形照片呈现一张斜放在棕色木桌上的黑白油毡刻印画。纸张白边沿左侧和下侧清楚可见，纸的上端指向右上方。版画内部，几匹马从左向右奔过深色而带肌理的前景。它们的身体被概括为强烈的黑色与浅色剪影，腿部伸展、尾巴向后扬起。一条宽阔弯曲的白色小路从下方中央进入，绕过马群，再向上穿入层叠山丘。道路两侧的前景填满紧密重复的刻痕和小型植物般痕迹。中景坡面较暗，被扫开的浅色带切开；地平线处低山位于大片近白天空下。微小鸟形散布上方天空，向顶部渐渐稀疏。每片明暗都来自未印纸面与黑墨的反差，局部灰色效果由密集细排线而非平滑涂色形成。摄影视点从上方略微斜看，因此印刷矩形随透视收窄，桌面露在边角。柔和环境光均匀照亮纸张，最深墨区仍近于黑色，白色刻线显得明亮。马形周围粗朴的切割边缘和重复刀痕赋予场景动势与明显手刻表面。整体构图以活跃的深色马群和纹理地面对照优雅浅色小路与广阔安静天空。
style_prompt_en: A hand-carved relief-print treatment depends on stark black ink against unprinted warm-white paper. Broad silhouettes carry the main shapes, while tightly repeated short gouges make rough gray-looking passages without continuous tonal wash. Pale curving bands sweep through denser dark fields, giving the eye a clear route across the composition. Edges are slightly jagged and lively, not mechanically uniform; alternating open and crowded areas provide scale and rhythm. Soft ambient illumination preserves the paper's matte texture, with no glossy highlights. A high, open light region balances the heavy lower ink mass. The visual result is graphic, energetic, and unmistakably tactile.
style_prompt_zh: 手刻凸版印刷效果依靠鲜明黑墨与未印的暖白纸面。宽阔剪影承担主要形状，紧密重复的短刀痕在没有连续色洗的情况下形成似灰色区域。浅色弯带扫过较密的深色域，为视线提供清楚路线。边缘略锯齿而有活力，并非机械均匀；开放与拥挤区域交替带来尺度和节奏。柔和环境光保留纸张哑光肌理，没有光亮高光。高处开放的浅色区域平衡下方厚重墨块。视觉结果图形感强、富于动势且触感鲜明。
theme_en: A black-and-white linocut of running horses and a winding pale path
theme_zh: 奔跑的马群与蜿蜒浅色小路的黑白油毡刻印画
name: Linocut print
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
